steps.title: Define Theme Tokens, Brand Palette, and Styles
steps.description: Establish rich emerald and slate color palettes, dimensional card elevations, input strokes, and typographic styling in colors.xml and styles.xml.

steps.title: Create Surface Drawables, Gradient Headers, and Metric Badges
steps.description: Design rounded corner cards, header gradients, metric container backgrounds, and color-coded status badges for inventory health and Khata alerts.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Schema, Data Models, and Sample Catalog
steps.description: Structure native SQLite tables for products, khata customers, sales transactions, line items, udhaar credit history, inward purchases, and daily store expenses.

steps.title: Build POS Dashboard Overview and Daily KPI Summaries
steps.description: Develop MainActivity featuring quick billing launch, real-time KPI counters (today's sales, pending udhaar, stock count, low stock warnings), and grid navigation.

steps.title: Construct Product Catalog, Search Filtering, and Stock Adjustment
steps.description: Implement product inventory list with real-time text query filtering, custom adapter rows with stock status, and add/edit form with deletion support.

steps.title: Implement Customer Khata Directory, Search, and Credit Tracking
steps.description: Create customer registry showcasing pending credit balances, live name/phone search filter, and onboarding form for new account creation.

steps.title: Build Customer Udhaar Ledger Timeline and Repayment Handler
steps.description: Construct customer transaction statement showing chronological credit purchases and repayments with one-click payment entry.

steps.title: Implement POS Billing Terminal, Live Cart Manager, and Checkout Engine
steps.description: Engineer sale checkout terminal with dropdown customer assignment, dynamic cart items, quantity calculators, discounts, and payment mode handling.

steps.title: Construct Sales Receipt Invoice Viewer and Bill History
steps.description: Design structured store invoice preview detailing invoice number, customer name, itemized bill breakdown, applied discounts, and net total paid.

steps.title: Implement Stock Inward Procurement Ledger and Supplier Restock
steps.description: Build inward restock history list and entry form that dynamically increments inventory stock counts and registers supplier costs.

steps.title: Build Store Overhead Daily Expense Logger and Categorization
steps.description: Develop store expense management module with categorized spending entries (rent, electricity, packaging, wages) and chronological log.

steps.title: Implement Business Financial Margins, Profit Analytics, and CSV Export
steps.description: Compute sales revenues, stock procurement overheads, operational expenses, net store margins, and generate CSV data backups.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Validate manifest configurations, compile resources, run code checks, and package the production Android application package.
